name: io.github.iambrettforbes/botsupply
title: BotSupply
description: Tamper-evident purchase receipts for agents: a record of what was reported as approved, plus delivery proof. Verified means the record hasn't changed; it doesn't confirm who approved. Wallets and escrow (test mode).

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. 'Bearer <wallet API key>' returned once by open_wallet. Required for get_balance, purchase, create_checkout unless api_key is passed as a tool argument.
